svg.title: A normalizer, an aggregator, and one integration owner
svg.desc: Two independent work packages implement the status normalizer and report aggregator against a frozen interface. The coordinator reviews both handoffs and runs the combined program plus candidate checks. Acceptance requires valid input behavior, preservation and the fixture report total4, done2, doneMinutes55; a correct-looking total alone cannot pass. A failed or unverified boundary returns to its owner.
